verdict.rationale: The product's core is a built-in Claude agent loop with the same tools as Claude Code, bundled with the CLI. Users delegate a task through query(), and Claude evaluates it, calls tools and repeats until done, for example finding and fixing bugs without manual intervention. It can also spawn subagents for focused subtasks and pause for user approval or clarifying questions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that task delegation works as documented, since all supporting evidence is vendor docs.
